sections.title: What {{product.withdrawnVersionLabel}} did (historical)
sections.lede: It worked with an ordinary Git repository and the tools and remotes already in use.

items.title: Project Registry
items.body: Bound canonical repository roots, working trees and target identities to explicit validation maps before running checks.

items.title: Isolated Runroom
items.body: Built and tested in bounded local checkouts, with step-by-step log capture and execution cancellation.
items.note: Runroom protected the main working tree; it was not an OS security sandbox.

items.title: Proof Ledger
items.body: Saved cryptographic, ECDSA P-256 signed run records binding source commit SHAs, test outcomes and build digests.
items.note: Local signatures verified payload integrity against local keys, not third-party issuer trust.

items.title: Recovery Vault
items.body: Prepared recovery bundles with explicitly recorded contents and rehearsed restoration into a separate location.
